# derived from spectrum

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:derivedFromSpectrum`](gmeow-derivedFromSpectrum.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/derivedFromSpectrum>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

Relates a [`PitchCollection`](../classes/gmeow-PitchCollection.md) to the [`Spectrum`](../classes/gmeow-Spectrum.md) it was derived from. The actual derivation is performed by fnSpectrumToPitchCollection ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:PitchCollection`](../classes/gmeow-PitchCollection.md) -> [`gmeow:Spectrum`](../classes/gmeow-Spectrum.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:derivedFromSpectrum`](gmeow-derivedFromSpectrum.md) from [`gmeow:PitchCollection`](../classes/gmeow-PitchCollection.md) to [`gmeow:Spectrum`](../classes/gmeow-Spectrum.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
